#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
#include <utility>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
ll n;
int sol = 1e9;

struct State {
    ll val;
    int cost;
};

void dfs(ll start, int startCost) {
    stack<State> st;
    st.push({start, startCost});
    while (!st.empty()) {
        State cur = st.top(); st.pop();
        ll v = cur.val;
        int c = cur.cost;
        if (c >= sol) continue;
        if (v == 0) {
            sol = c;
            continue;
        }
        ll s = 1;
        int digits = 1;
        while (s * 10 + 1 <= v) {
            s = s * 10 + 1;
            digits++;
        }
        // push second branch first so that first branch is processed first
        st.push({s * 10 + 1 - v, c + digits + 1});
        st.push({v % s, c + digits * (v / s)});
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> n;
    dfs(n, 0);
    cout << sol;
    return 0;
}
